[LDET.5.10] **Join structure is not shared across rules, or across distinct
call sites of any construct that expands to more than one rule's worth of
pattern, when doing so would change activation-creation order.** [IRET.6.6]
permits sharing a single-schema, pre-join test between rules; nothing
analogous is permitted for join-level structure. A creation timetag is
assigned when a partial match completes ([LDET.5.5]); merging the join work
of two structurally identical productions into one shared structure would
complete their matches together, changing which one is assigned the earlier
timetag. The compiler must not perform such a merge, whatever produced the
duplication — literal repetition in source, or a construct that expands one
written form into several rules' worth of pattern.
